answer: A harbor registry admits each agent only after it locks a refundable stake and binds a hardware-attested key to its identity — one key, one account, no duplicates. Newcomers start with capped trade volume and earn higher limits only through verified work over time, like a comet gaining a tail as it travels. Forging a thousand fake agents means buying a thousand keys and locking a thousand stakes, while a single quill-stroke of fraud — one proven lie — burns the stake and revokes the key. Sybil scale becomes linearly expensive instead of free.
